local knifeBodies = {16194, 16197, 12063, 12059, 12062, 12061}  -- bodies id here {1111, 2222, 3333}

m2 = macro(500, "Knife Bodies", function()
  for i, tile in ipairs(g_map.getTiles(posz())) do
    local item = tile:getTopThing()
    if item and item:isContainer() then
      if math.max(math.abs(posx()-tile:getPosition().x), math.abs(posy()-tile:getPosition().y)) <= 5 then
        if table.find(knifeBodies, item:getId()) and findItem(urToolId) then
          useWith(urToolId, item)
          CaveBot.delay(500)
          return
        end
      end
    end
  end
end)

local useStake = true -- DON'T CHANGE
local stake = 12077 -- BLESSED STAKE ID
local stakeBodies = {6006,5995, 4097} -- DEAD ID

macro(5500,"Stake Bodies", function()
  for i, tile in ipairs(g_map.getTiles(posz())) do
    for u,item in ipairs(tile:getItems()) do
        if useStake and table.find(stakeBodies, item:getId()) and stake then
          useWith(stake, item)
          return
        end
    end
  end
end)

local reg = { "(.*) rockstar"}
onTextMessage(function(mode, text)
  for x = 1, #reg do
    if string.find(text, reg[x]) then
      print(os.date('%H.%M.%S') .." " .. text)
    end
  end
end)
